Saks Wellness Center has been serving the Gaylord, MI community for nearly 50 years with a whole-person approach to care. Our clinic brings together chiropractic, rehabilitative therapies, functional nutrition, massage, neuropathy treatment, and supportive wellness services under one roof.

On this channel, you’ll find walkthroughs of our clinic, introductions to our doctors and staff, patient education, and explanations of how we approach care. Our goal is to help you understand what we do, how we do it, and whether our approach may be a good fit for you before you ever walk through the door.

We believe listening comes first, and healing follows.
